evidence_class: Static: bounded working-core review; no compile, Rust test, Python/candidate replay, physical command, or target execution by reviewer
review_scope: Integrated BVLS-03 numerical core in detached stage1/lib: eligibility, residual order, factor reuse, private scratch, final checks, unchanged BVLS-02 continuation, typed failures, and dimension-aware reservation linkage. Incomplete observation/API coverage and full counter plumbing were excluded for the later frozen-body review.

source_custody.limitation: The stage1 source moved after substantive inspection and before closure. Findings below are attributable to the twice-observed a91ed69d cut. The closing ba0548ed cut is not reviewed or approved; the durable patch aided source context but is not asserted to be an exact snapshot of a91ed69d.

findings.finding: Eligibility calls the EFT normal-or-zero guard on every p0 coordinate and treats any error as ineligibility. A completed finite, box-feasible, strict-interior p0 with a free subnormal therefore falls through to BVLS-02 rather than entering refinement and returning the required source-operand typed refusal.
findings.required_fix: Separate algebraic eligibility active-bit equality from post-entry EFT source guarding. Once the specified lambda/box/active/radius predicates admit the face, a guarded source-domain failure must return a refinement refusal with no BVLS-02 fallback.

findings.finding: The refusal kinds are swapped: refinement_refusal constructs TrustRegionOptimalityIndeterminate, while unchanged KKT optimality failures construct TrustRegionRefinementIndeterminate. This mislabels true refinement failures and changes ineligible BVLS-02 failure behavior.
findings.required_fix: Use TrustRegionRefinementIndeterminate only for failures originating after refinement entry; retain TrustRegionOptimalityIndeterminate for unchanged BVLS-02 KKT/enclosure failures.

findings.finding: A p1 lambda_norm arithmetic failure is hardcoded as refinement_subnormal_intermediate although lambda_norm reports nonfinite norm arithmetic. Overflow/nonfinite failures are therefore mislabeled as subnormal; a finite norm above radius is separately and correctly a scratch-radius refusal.
findings.required_fix: Map nonfinite ordered-norm arithmetic to the stable nonfinite refinement reason and reserve refinement_scratch_radius for a finite norm exceeding the radius.

findings.location: crates/openwepp-land-surface-energy/src/m1_trust_region_stage1.rs controls05 one-less reservation and its future adapter
findings.finding: The retained capture has 20 free coordinates, but the control supplies the 21-free global maxima K=95784 and G=287607. The real dimension-aware core requires K(20)=92038 and G(20)=276367, so a one-less global-max reservation would admit the actual retained face and could only pass through a caller-driven or fabricated denial.
findings.required_fix: Correct the retained control to remaining K=92037/G=276366 and required K=92038/G=276367. The thin adapter must derive and enforce the actual free-dimension requirement from the shared core rather than accepting caller-provided expected work as authority.

conforming_observations: The a91ed69d cut formed ordinary r0 in the existing sum-Ap-then-add-f binary64 order and formed r1 through the shared frozen 22-term Dot2 order.
Both corrections reused the same retained JacobiFactor through the same lambda_step operation and added no refactorization or third correction.
p1 remained in a private RefinementScratch and was consumed only by its norm, second residual, and retained factor application before p2 construction.
The final path checked original scaled box feasibility, active-value preservation, and ordered radius before installing p2 for unchanged crossing/KKT logic; masks were not changed within refinement.
